editedSummaries.body: Re-reviewed after the rebase: the conflict resolution looks mostly right, one nit left.

instructions: The branch has merge conflicts (see `**branch**` above). Resolve them before committing and pushing.
Read every item marked `[edited since first look]`, including edited summaries and edited first-look bullets, before deciding whether to resolve a matching thread.
Commit any remaining changes and push the conflict resolution.
For any substantial decision or rejection, append `- <decision>` to Shepherd Journal with `pr-shepherd apply journal 42 '- <decision>'`.
Link threads and comments from their headings. Cite reviews by ID.

`[FIX_CODE]` is non-terminal. After completing these steps, continue with the next poll using the same interface and mode: rerun the current `pr-shepherd` CLI invocation with its flags, or call MCP `iterate` again.
